TC-028 Removing a Plivo account results in an inconsistent workflow with no user guidance, preventing reconfiguration. Existing User Journey User logged-in > Phone Numbers > +Add Number CTA > Account / Number > Enter details > Add > Delete Plivo account > +Add Number again > Use an existing account > Add Phone number > Add number CTA > Telephony Accounts > Disable > +Add Number CTA > Setup New Account After adding a Plivo phone number, the page displays two sections: Phone Numbers: Displays the added phone number details (Provider, Number, Label, Account, Status, Added). Telephony Account: Displays the configured account details (Provider, Label, Auth ID, Numbers, Added). When the user removes the added Plivo account: 1. The Phone Numbers section is removed and displays "No phone numbers registered yet." 2. The Telephony Account section updates the Numbers count accordingly. However, after refreshing the page: 1. The Telephony Account section collapses automatically. 2. Attempting to add a phone number using the existing account results in the validation error "Pick an account", even after selecting the account. 3. Navigating back shows the Telephony Account section again, but it appears disabled. 4. The user is left without any indication of what action is required next (e.g., re-enable the account, reselect it, or create a new account). The workflow becomes confusing and prevents the user from successfully continuing the configuration. Note : No need to close the "telephony accounts".
